mechanism_narrative: A negative month-over-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary easing cycle, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS monthly change signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods with negative FEDFUNDS change.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicates accelerating labor market weakness, which triggers short-term equity sell-offs due to recession concerns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.2pp in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE change signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the past month signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint decline signal (both HOUST and RSAFS down) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below its 12-month moving average), a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates worsening supply chain disruptions, which increases inflation expectations and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the INDPRO decline signal in the supply-constrained regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 12mo MA and declines.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and short-term equity market declines, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL YoY signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A negative month-over-month change in housing starts (HOUST) reflects deteriorating consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the HOUST monthly change signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods with negative HOUST change.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a sharp contraction in the labor market, which increases recession risks and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint signal (UNRATE up and PAYEMS down) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level below 105 indicates a significant supply-side contraction, which disrupts corporate production and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO level signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
